name: room-development
description: G-R-04: the suite of the development room's gated roles (Frontend / UI-UX Developer, DevOps Engineer), run as a room trial before either is enabled (eval --suite room-development). The core pipeline roles of the room are enabled already; the gate counts only tasks done by the gated roles. Checks are offline: an HTML accessibility check with html.parser and a Dockerfile check of the text.

tasks.name: accessible-form
tasks.title: Make the sign-up form in static/signup.html accessible
tasks.description: static/signup.html is the sign-up page. Make it accessible (WCAG 2.2 basics): the page states its language, every form control has a visible label tied to it, the logo image has a text alternative, and the submit button has a name. Keep the field names email, name and newsletter. Change only static/signup.html.

files.static/signup.html: Newsletter

tasks.name: dockerfile
tasks.title: Write a Dockerfile for the app in app.py
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile at the repository root that runs app.py (a standard-library HTTP server on port 8000) with Python 3.12. Requirements: a pinned base image tag (not latest), the dependency file requirements.txt copied and installed before the code is copied, the app runs as a non-root user, port 8000 is exposed, a HEALTHCHECK, and CMD in exec (JSON array) form. Change only Dockerfile.

files.checks/check_dockerfile.py:
import json
import re

lines = []
for raw in open('Dockerfile').read().replace('\\\n', ' ').splitlines():
    raw = raw.strip()
    if raw and not raw.startswith('#'):
        lines.append(raw)
ins = [(l.split(None, 1)[0].upper(), l.split(None, 1)[1] if ' ' in l else '') for l in lines]
kinds = [k for k, _ in ins]
froms = [v for k, v in ins if k == 'FROM']
assert froms, 'no FROM'
image = froms[-1].split()[0]
assert image.startswith('python:3.12'), f'base image {image} is not Python 3.12'
assert ':' in image and not image.endswith(':latest'), 'pin the base image tag'
copies = [(n, v) for n, (k, v) in enumerate(ins) if k in ('COPY', 'ADD')]
req = [n for n, v in copies if 'requirements.txt' in v]
code = [n for n, v in copies if 'requirements.txt' not in v]
install = [n for n, (k, v) in enumerate(ins) if k == 'RUN' and 'pip' in v and 'requirements.txt' in v]
assert req and install and code, 'copy requirements.txt, install it, then copy the code'
assert req[0] < install[0] < code[0], 'install the dependencies before the code is copied (layer caching)'
assert not any(k == 'ADD' and re.search(r'https?://', v) for k, v in ins), 'ADD from a URL'
users = [v.strip() for k, v in ins if k == 'USER']
assert users and users[-1].split(':')[0] not in ('root', '0'), 'run as a non-root user'
assert any(k == 'EXPOSE' and '8000' in v for k, v in ins), 'expose port 8000'
assert 'HEALTHCHECK' in kinds, 'add a HEALTHCHECK'
cmd = [v for k, v in ins if k == 'CMD']
assert cmd, 'no CMD'
form = json.loads(cmd[-1])
assert isinstance(form, list) and any('app.py' in x for x in form), 'CMD in exec form running app.py'
